message: ルール
The first day of exams ended safely... well, barely, at least, and I'm still only halfway there.
I should go study at the library for tomorrow.
The atmosphere inside the library was a little different from what I had expected.
I headed toward the reading seats--I always sit there whenever I use the library.
The carpet beneath my feet is soft. I can hear the second hand of the wall clock ticking away.
Melilot-san appeared and exchanged a greeting with me using only our eyes.
Her gentle expression already suggested she had successfully protected the tranquility of the library.
...Once exams begin, hordes of students who don't normally use the library come rushing in. That in itself is a good thing.
However, even though they supposedly came to study for exams, before long they start chatting away as if they were in a classroom during self-study.
And then, they get tossed outside by Melilot-san. No chance for excuses is given.

name: Melilot
message: 「Reciting aloud is fine, at least.」

name: Synn
message: 「That sounds useful for English and classical literature exams.」
Melilot-san tilted her head slightly and gestured for me to head to my usual spot.
Even though it's the exact same silence as always, it gives off a cheerful impression.
My usual spot--that said, of course there are no reserved seats.
The regular students who come to the library each fulfill their own roles, regardless of differences in grade level.
They claim their own chair at a reading desk, never moving from or giving up that spot. Some have even claimed a sofa a little further away as their favorite place.
In that way, we listen closely to the sound of each other turning pages. We share our time with just the few people around us.
Slightly mysterious acquaintances whose names and grades I don't even know.
Now that I've been elected Student Council President, everyone probably knows who I am, and I'm sure they'd introduce themselves if I asked.
Still, asking them about that feels somehow wrong.
People who cherish the joy of reading books, people who can share in that--that alone is enough.
Just before reaching my usual spot, my feet came to a halt. An unfamiliar student was sitting in my place, diligently studying for exams.
Naturally, no one has the right to monopolize a seat in the library, so when a non-regular suddenly takes it, all you can do is gracefully give it up.
One of my library companions noticed me and tossed a wry smile my way in lieu of a greeting.
I see, the reason Melilot-san looked so happy was--
I take a different seat than usual and look toward Melilot-san.
The afternoon sunlight streaming in through the window cast meaningful shadows across the librarian's face.
...Now then, let's start studying for the test.
